player_prompt.intro: Waxaad ku ciyaareysaa {color} ciyaar ah Breakthrough. Waxaad ku dhaqaaqdaa {direction} loox {board_size}x{board_size} ah. Marka aad soo jeesato waxaad dhaqaajin kartaa hal gabal hal talaabo hore ama midab-ka-midab ah. Xubin ayaa kaliya u dhaqaaqi karta midab-ka-midab haddii uu jiro gabal ka soo horjeeda, oo kaliya u dhaqaaqaya square sida mashquulsan ee tallaabada iskutallaabta. Markaad gasho square leh gabal ka soo horjeeda, waad qabsanaysaa oo gabalka ka soo horjeeda ayaa si joogto ah looga saaraa looxda. Isticmaal calaamadeynta UCI-sida ee ku jirta qaybaha, tusaale ahaan [a2a3] si aad uga guurto a2 ilaa a3. * 'a' waxay u dhigantaa tiirka bidix, '1' waa safka hoose (laga soo bilaabo aragtida White). * Guriga madow waa safka sare (safka 8 for 8x8). Guriga caddaar waa safka hoose (safka 1 for 8x8). Haddii ciyaaryahanka ugu horreeya uu gaaro safka gurigaaga, waad lumineysaa.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fadlan isticmaal calaamadda aljebrada ee ku jirta qaybta sida [a2a3].
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Move is out of board bounds.
invalid_move.illegal: That move does not follow the Breakthrough rules or is not your piece.

outcome.black_reached: Madowgu wuxuu gaadhay safka guriga ee Cad.
outcome.white_captured: Dhamaan ciyaarta caddaan waa la qabtay.
outcome.black_captured: Dhamaan ciyaartoyda madow waa la qabtay.
outcome.no_moves: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ma laha talaabooyin dheeraad ah.
